page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, resulting in 64 vCPUs. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

This server type does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation without hyperthreading offers predictable compute performance per resource, making it suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution without resource contention.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU cores, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded application servers, medium-sized databases, and compute-intensive tasks that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated physical execution units.
